messages:
mike: Quick thread for onboarding channel norms + a tiny cheatsheet I wish I had day 0. TL;DR: where to ask what, how to reduce noise, and small pro tips. :memo:

emma: perfect. can we get a one-line template for intros and what to pin?

mike: Intro template: `Name | Team | Manager | Timezone | Pronouns | 1-sentence what I'll work on | Fun fact` 

mike: Pin these links to #new-hires: onboarding checklist, VPN/setup doc, equipment tracker, security quickstart.

it-bot: Equipment order #A-789 created for emma. ETA 3 business days.

mike: Where to post things:
- Access/VPN/laptop: #help (infra) or DM IT for urgent
- HR/payroll/badge: DM @peopleops or use the portal (link pinned)
- Team questions: post in your team channel (e.g., #eng, #product). If it's hiring/roles, use #people-ops-tag.
- General newbie questions: keep in #new-hires so others can see answers

ben_cs: Small nuance on team channels: when asking about code or an incident, include repo/link, minimal repro, and a short log snippet. Helps us triage faster.

emma: Any guidelines about threading vs new messages?

mike: Always reply in thread for the same topic. Start a new message if the topic changes. Threading keeps channels scannable. If you cross-post, add context like "Cross-posted to #eng-infra for visibility".

olivia: FYI about reactions: we use :thumbsup: for ACK, :eyes: to say "looking", and :white_check_mark: when fixed. Don't assume silence means ignored.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Day 1 items pending for emma  Complete W-9, Review employee handbook, Schedule 1:1 with manager.

emma: Noise control: how do I stop deploy and CI pings?

mike: Two options: 1) Channel-level: channel header -> Notifications -> Mute. 2) Bot-level: open the bot's last config message and type `unsubscribe` or click the unsubscribe link. Some bots also support `/botname settings` to opt-out.

mike: Also, set your Slack Preferences -> Sidebar -> Show all unread = off if you want to focus.

ben_cs: Security tip: never paste creds or tokens in any channel. Use our Secrets vault (link pinned) and reference the secret name in chat if needed.

emma: Are there any quiet hours or timezone rules? I'm UTC+2 and don't want to ping folks at midnight their time.

mike: Core hours are 10:00-16:00 PT for meetings. When messaging across timezones, add your timezone and avoid @channel outside core hours unless it's urgent. Use `@oncall` for paging.

it-bot: Onboard checklist updated: VPN confirmed, SSO linked.

mike: Final bits: add a one-line "help-needed" header when you post a request, e.g., `Help: stuck on VPN auth (steps tried)` so folks can skim. And drop a 1-liner intro to #introductions (use the intro template). Welcome! :tada:
